title: soranthe lanata
intro: Soranthe lanata, commonly known as the velvet vine, is a perennial climber native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Soranthe lanata include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in treating wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Soranthe lanata include iridoids and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
